text: Shows a skill as a small icon (22px, so it fits in a line of text; with a black and an orange border over its edge) with its name beside it. When the pointer rests on the icon or the name, the skill's tooltip card (Template:Skill) opens beside it. Usage {{SkillLink|10667}} {{SkillLink|10667|tip=left}} The first value is the skill ID (the number at the end of https://aa-classic.com/database/skills/10667). The icon, name and card come from the data pages stored by sync_wiki_data.py (the same pages as Template:Skill; --scan finds the SkillLink calls on the wiki). A skill that is not stored yet shows nothing (an invisible comment is left in the page source) until the script has been run. The card opens to the right of the skill (towards the middle of the page for normal text). tip=left opens it to the left instead, for skills at the right edge, for example in an infobox. tip=no turns the tooltip off. size=32 makes the icon larger (default 22, which fits in a line of text). On phones the card opens below. The colour of the name is set in Template:SkillLink/styles.css (.aa-skilltip-name). Needs Module:Skill, Module:DataStore, Module:IconName, Template:Skill and Template:SkillLink/styles.css. No description. Use 32 or more for lists and boxes. Number optional Tooltip tip The card opens to the right of the skill. Write left to open it to the left instead (skills at the right edge of the page), or no to turn the tooltip off. Suggested values left no String optional
html:
Shows a skill as a small icon (22px, so it fits in a line of text; with a black and an orange border over its edge) with its name beside it. When the pointer rests on the icon or the name, the skill's tooltip card (Template:Skill) opens beside it.

Usage 

{{SkillLink|10667}}
{{SkillLink|10667|tip=left}}
  • The first value is the skill ID (the number at the end of https://aa-classic.com/database/skills/10667).
  • The icon, name and card come from the data pages stored by sync_wiki_data.py (the same pages as Template:Skill; --scan finds the SkillLink calls on the wiki). A skill that is not stored yet shows nothing (an invisible comment is left in the page source) until the script has been run.
  • The card opens to the right of the skill (towards the middle of the page for normal text). tip=left opens it to the left instead, for skills at the right edge, for example in an infobox. tip=no turns the tooltip off. size=32 makes the icon larger (default 22, which fits in a line of text). On phones the card opens below.
  • The colour of the name is set in Template:SkillLink/styles.css (.aa-skilltip-name).
  • Needs Module:Skill, Module:DataStore, Module:IconName, Template:Skill and Template:SkillLink/styles.css.

No description.
